svg.aria-label: An inspection line on a bench plate. A carriage carrying a plate of 48 test pins rides two rails past three C-frame stations: a drafting head that lowers a lens and drops a plan card without touching the plate, a press whose die stamps the pins while a dial counts the run, and a seating gauge that lands on the plate only when it has no blocking findings. A failed seat sends the carriage back to the press and steps a round counter, up to three rounds.
